name: Kreuztal (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided yellow over blue, charged at the centre with the city arms of Kreuztal (a hunting horn on yellow above a yellow saltire on blue).
history: The city flag, the city banner and the arms were approved on 12 November 1970; gold (orange) is the colour of Orange and blue that of the former principality of Nassau.

features.role: Kreuztal arms — hunting horn and saltire
